$comment: Promotion policy for the Airlock release gate. Fail closed: the gate blocks on anything missing, malformed, or unknown. Changes to this file are themselves a 'high' risk-tier change and require review per SECURITY-CONTROLS.md.

risk_tier_guidance.standard: Docs, corpus content, test-only changes. Full evidence set, no human approval.
risk_tier_guidance.elevated: Application logic changes, dependency changes, prompt/tool changes. One named approver.
risk_tier_guidance.high: Changes to the policy gate, release gate, provenance, workflow, or this policy file. Two named approvers.
